fact: BIPA's page says company and close corporation registration forms are submitted in triplicate to BIPA offices, and register records are inspected by a file request at a BIPA office or by email, with files delivered from off-premises storage in about 3 to 5 days.

BIPA announced the kick-off meeting with the developer of its new Integrated Business Registration System (IBRS), which aims to allow full business incorporation within 60 minutes; go-live is still ahead.

Namibia's Deputy Minister of Industrialization and Trade told the National Assembly that the Business and Intellectual Property Authority has collected beneficial ownership information as part of business registration since 7 August 2023, with 64,356 of 221,338 entities in the business register having submitted it by 30 June 2024.
